title.value: TaiwanICDF International Higher Education Scholarship Program
title.evidence_quote: TaiwanICDF International Higher Education Scholarship Program

field: Degree programmes at partner universities in Taiwan
qualifications: Online application covers both the TaiwanICDF Scholarship and the Taiwan-Europe Scholarship
Documents are also submitted through the ROC (Taiwan) embassy or representative office in the applicant's country
Incomplete or inaccurate applications are not processed
description_short: TaiwanICDF scholarships fund international students in degree programmes at partner universities in Taiwan. The 2027 online application, covering the TaiwanICDF Scholarship and the Taiwan-Europe Scholarship, runs from 1 December 2026 to 15 March 2027.
